name: Select
summary: One choice from a list that's too long, or changes too often, to show as options side by side, at seven sizes, with an optional leading icon, a placeholder, grouped and unavailable options, a loading and an empty list, and the commit states when the choice is saved. Not for two states (use Switch) or for a handful of fixed options always worth seeing (use SegmentedControl). With `search` it is the combobox: typing narrows a long list (F15.44; no separate Combobox, as a one-time code is a TextField type). Picking people or free tags as a value is TagInput's job. Owner F10 (2026-11-07): the list is the library's own, built from the one ListItem that menus use, not the platform's.
a11y: The WAI-ARIA APG select-only combobox: a `button[role=combobox]` named by the visible label, with `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls` and `aria-activedescendant` pointing into a `listbox` of ListItem options, so focus stays on the combobox and its focus ring stays visible. The selected option carries `aria-selected` and a check mark; an unavailable one `aria-disabled`; a group is `role=group` named by its heading. The list opens in the top layer under the field (above near the window's end). Read-only sets `aria-readonly` and doesn't open; while a choice saves the box is `aria-busy` and `aria-disabled`, focus stays on it, and "Saved" is announced politely. `name` adds a hidden input for forms; `error` sets `aria-invalid` and is read with the hint. Targets: 44 px and up from `normal`; `xs` and `s` are dense exceptions.

keys.keys: Arrow Down, Arrow Up, Enter or Space
keys.action: opens the list at the chosen option
move through the options, skipping unavailable ones
move to the first or last option
moves to the next option starting with it, open or closed
chooses the option and closes the list
chooses the option, closes the list and moves on
closes the list without changing the choice
chooses the option, or unchooses it; the list stays open
chooses every option from the last one chosen to this one
chooses all, or none when all are chosen
closes the list and applies the choices

opens the list and narrows it; Space types. Home and End move the caret; Enter chooses (multiple: toggles); the arrows, Tab and Escape work as above. `search` is the APG editable combobox with list autocomplete: an `input[role=combobox]` with `aria-autocomplete="list"`, and the number of matches announced politely.

props.name: label
props.description: A noun phrase naming the choice, with no colon: "Current revision".

props.name: mode
props.description: `commit` (default): the choice applies and saves at once, with saving, saved and failed states. `form` (IP14): one field of a form saved together with one Save button: `onChange` just reports the choice; no state or "Saved" shows on the field.

props.name: savedText
props.description: Announced once a choice is saved: "Saved" (IP14).

props.name: size
props.description: The Button size scale: the box is xs 24, s 36, normal 44 (default), m 48, l 56, xl 64 or xxl 80 px high. The label, hint and list keep their size.

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Hides the visible label where the row's heading or the icon already says what it is (a design tool's inspector). It still names the field.

props.name: icon
props.description: A leading icon that says what kind of choice it is. Decorative: the label names the field.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while nothing is chosen: an instruction in the label's words, "Choose a country".

props.name: hint
props.description: One short sentence about the choice.

props.name: applied
props.description: A filter is applied: the chosen value differs from its default, so the control is marked in the accent (`c.applied.fill` and `c.applied.border`, theme settings) while the value it shows says what. Pair it with a way to clear it; to mark the clear button too, put `data-applied` (the same mark, as a context attribute) on a wrapper around both.

props.name: width
props.description: `fill` (default) takes its row's width, up to a measure; `content` is as wide as its label and chosen value, for a choice at the end of a heading row or in a toolbar (LR38).

props.name: optional
props.description: Marks the label "(optional)". Choices are required by default, so only optional ones are marked.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Shows the choice without letting it change; still focusable and read.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The choice can't change here. Prefer `readOnly`, or say why in the hint.

props.name: loading
props.description: The options are still arriving: a spinner in the box and "Loading options…" in the list.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Why the list is empty and what to do, shown in the list when there are no options.

props.name: failedText
props.description: What happened and what was kept, when a save fails. Defaults to naming the field and the kept choice.

props.name: name
props.description: Submits the value with a form under this name (a hidden input).

props.name: search
props.description: Type to narrow the list (the combobox): the box becomes a text input, and the list shows the options whose label contains what's typed. For lists long enough that scrolling is slow, about 15 options and up. Only listed options can be chosen.

props.name: orientation
props.description: `horizontal` puts the label beside the box, a third of the row (dense settings and property panels), as Field's.

props.name: noMatchText
props.description: What the list says when nothing matches what's typed. Defaults to "Nothing matches “…”".

props.name: onSearch
props.description: Called with what's typed, for options that come from a server: fetch, set `loading` while waiting, then pass the results as `options` (they're still narrowed by what's typed).

props.name: label
props.description: What the person reads in the list.

props.name: description
props.description: One short line under the label, when options need telling apart, or why an unavailable one can't be chosen.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon from the active set.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shown but can't be chosen now; the keyboard skips it. Say why in `description`.

props.name: group
props.description: A heading the option sits under. Options of one group must be next to each other.

props.name: multiple
props.description: One choice (default).

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen option's value; `''` when nothing is chosen yet, which shows the placeholder.

props.name: onChange
props.description: The newly chosen value; the choice applies at once. Return a promise for a save: the box shows saving, then a tick; reject it and the stored choice comes back with Retry.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Any number of choices: each option gets a box, the list stays open while choosing, and the choices apply once, when the list closes. For a handful of options always worth seeing, use checkboxes instead.

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen options' values; `[]` shows the placeholder.

props.name: onChange
props.description: The chosen values, in the options' order, once the list closes with a different choice. Return a promise for a save, as with one choice.
